title: Define NNTP session state enum and transition rules
description:
Define SessionState enum: Authenticating (before AUTHINFO or when auth_required=true), Active (normal operation, no group selected), GroupSelected (GROUP has been issued, article pointer valid). For TLS: add a NotSecure/Secure boolean dimension. Document the valid command set per state and the transitions. Artifact: reader/src/session/state.rs.

Acceptance: all valid state transitions documented; commands that are invalid in a given state enumerated; unit test: invalid command in wrong state returns 480 (auth required) or 412 (no group selected)
